title: Corpus gap: no ADRs exist for report engine, query layer, or result set architecture
body: The artifact corpus for tableflip has a structural gap: no ADRs, ASRs, design docs, or plan files exist despite major architectural decisions being made during the preact rebuild (7 report modules, 5-layer architecture, query builder patterns). All institutional knowledge lives only in agent execution logs. This means future features that touch report/query/export layers have no formal constraint documentation to reference. These would have been valuable for the current subreport design task.

title: Corpus search for subreport detail rows design — comprehensive findings
body:
Corpus search completed for "subreport detail rows" feature design task. Findings:

ARTIFACT STATE:
- ADRs: 0 exist (entire corpus)
- ASRs: 0 exist
- Design docs: 2 exist (DD-preact-rebuild-architecture.md, CONTRACTS.md) — both about preact rebuild, not subreport features
- Plans: 7 completed plans (TASK-preact-A through F) — all about preact rebuild
- Logs: 43 entries from preact rebuild (June 12-13, 2026)

KEY ARCHITECTURAL CONSTRAINTS (from CONTRACTS.md + logs):
1. ResultSet shape: {columns: string[], rows: Record<string,unknown>[], metadata} — fully homogeneous, all rows share same column set
2. _row_type marker column exists for subtotals: 0=detail, 1=subtotal, 2=spacer, 3=grand total
3. Subtotals builder (sql-subtotals.ts) uses UNION ALL with band tagging (_row_type, _sort_row_type, _sort_group_N) — closest existing pattern to subreport detail rows
4. No concept of "child queries" exists — all queries operate on single base table with JOINs
5. Engine uses buildQueryPlan() as orchestrator, dispatches to sql-detail/sql-grouped/sql-totals/sql-subtotals
6. Export is single-sheet XLSX or CSV, no multi-sheet support
7. Lookup mechanism: LookupSpec interface with rightId, keyPairs, cols, required, enabled, duplicatePolicy
8. LookupStage UI component exists for configuring joins
9. Five-layer architecture: core → catalog → query → report → UI

GAPS IDENTIFIED:
- No ADRs for report engine architecture, query builder patterns, or result set shape conventions
- All institutional knowledge lives in agent execution logs
- Biggest architectural gap: ResultSet assumes homogeneous columns; supporting heterogeneous rows (each row with own column set + band ID) would require changes to ResultSet, grid renderer, and export formatter

RELEVANT LOGS:
- support-researcher L1: Thorough 5-layer analysis (HIGH relevance)
- exec-executor L34: Calc column gap in detail queries — resolveRef() returns quoted alias, not computed SQL (HIGH)
- exec-executor L12: Engine architecture — single query plan, no multi-band support (HIGH)
- exec-executor L27: stack-sheets.tsx is existing UNION ALL precedent (MEDIUM)
- exec-executor L29: Export system in ui/export.ts (MEDIUM)

CONCLUSION: This is a greenfield feature with no prior architectural decisions recorded. The subtotals UNION ALL pattern is the closest precedent. Design must address: (1) heterogeneous result set shape, (2) child query orchestration, (3) multi-band export formatting, (4) UI for configuring detail bands.
